newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 3.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Thursday's Daily Variety:

HOLLYWOOD - Sony Corp's Sony Pictures Entertainment Chairman Alan Levine resigned from his post in response to news that John Calley of United Artists was in final negotiations to move to Sony in a senior position.
PARIS - NBC Europe will air digitally in France on Canal Plus SA's platform, Canal Satellite. The deal will be officially unveiled in Paris.
